newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Strong demand seen at Portugal bond sales.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Strong demand seen at Portugal bond sales.

text.p: Demand was expected to be strong at the Portuguese credit institute's auction of 20 billion escudos each of a new series of five and 10-year bonds (OT) on Tuesday, analysts said.
Bids for the March 2002 paper were seen between 5.75 and 5.80 percent, while those for the February 2007 were seen at 6.60-6.6875 percent.
The results will be be released around 1100 GMT.
The auction will set the coupon for both issues. The coupon on the old five-year series, the March 2001, was 8.75 percent, while it stood at 9.5 percent on the February 2006.
The March 2001 closed on the secondary market at a yield of 5.596 percent, while the 10-year ended at 6.58 percent.
